name: Taimi's Toolbench
description: Taimi's Toolbench aims to be your ultimate in-game crafting companion. Plan the most efficient way to craft anything from simple items to legendaries, taking into account your inventory, materials, recipes, achievements and more. A crafting ranker helps you find out which items on your wishlist you're closest to completing, or your progress against a list of items you want to craft in priority order. An account snapshot tool allows you to quickly search any item across your entire account and pop-out windows for your shopping list and crafting steps let you keep that info handy in game while you craft, play or shop.

account.details: Required for account info and coin balance

characters.details: Required to list characters and read their inventories

inventories.details: Required for bank, shared inventory, materials, and character bags

unlocks.details: Used to check which recipes your account has learned and to read your Legendary Armory

builds.details: Used to count the gear your characters are wearing as items you already own

progression.details: Used to check whether you have the achievements and masteries a vendor requires before it will trade
